headline: EPS swings to a profit sequentially, surges year-over-year
summary_short: POSCO Holdings reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩9,055, swinging from a ₩2,980 per-share loss last quarter and up 328.3% y/y from ₩2,114.
summary_long: EPS of ₩9,055 swung from a ₩2,980 per-share loss in the prior quarter and rose 328.3% year-over-year from ₩2,114. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. The Aug-14 6-K's EX-99.1 exhibit turned out to be a Corporate Governance Report (fiscal 2025), not the Q2 2026 earnings release; the 3-fetch budget (EDGAR filing-list browse, filing index, exhibit) was exhausted without landing a parseable earnings primary.
